acceptance_policy: Do not label source geometry as model equilibrium or require its individual forces to be zero.
No exact PBE energy or atomization/bond energy target is invented.
Density count and symmetry are necessary conditions, not complete physical validation.
A02 resolves engine/basis/export bytes; A03 resource run is exploratory and not a scientific pass.
Model changes or tolerance changes require an explicit new profile/plan revision with reason; no automatic fallback.
The file checksum covers UTF-8 bytes; it is not RFC8785 scientific-state identity.
A01 completion is design/input consistency only; all engine/numerical/physical checks remain not_executed.
